Display_ADF.note: mesh quad in the local XY plane facing -Z (towards the pilot), pivot at its centre, UV 0..1 = the visible window (u to the right, v up); material M_Screen (dark LCD). Draw live content into it (RenderTexture on its material, or a world-space canvas of this size at this transform).
